name: FEEL FOR YOU
source:
Main character is a salary man. One day he finds a strange promotional flyer in his mailbox showing off various costumes. After making a phone call, he gets to know he can order a girl in any of these costumes...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是個上班族。一天，他在自家信箱裡發現一張奇怪的廣告單，上面展示著五花八門的服裝。他打了個電話才知道，只要挑出其中一套，就能叫來一位穿著那身打扮的女孩……

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]］
